label: NOTE: THE SEVEN NAMED BELOW ARE NOW ALL CAUGHT -- 95 mutations, 95 caught, 0 NOT caught, 0 equivalent.  Kept as history of what each took, since the reasoning is what a stale count would otherwise throw away.
why: (1) `the ramp value is stored before the step, not after` and (2) `the non-ramp arm leaves the receive buffer's first sample alone`: `poke()` now seeds the echo canceller's `echoCoeff`/`echoHistory` with a real (if arbitrary) nonzero filter, so the FILTER_ONLY arm and the `out[0]==177.0f` BYPASS arm stop being the same arithmetic; "ramp near end" (already in the table, ecRampCounter 176->177) now separates the two orders, and a new "rx0 stale sentinel" row pre-loads rx[0] with 177.0f via the new `rxSeedOn`/`rxSeedVal` fields so the dropped `rx[0] = 0.0f;` leaves the stale sentinel in place instead of an already-zero word.  (3, 4, 5) the three exit* mutations: a new `p3state` field pokes `phase3Modulator->state` to V92P3M_STATE_JA/SU_SECOND/TRN1U_SECOND on three new rows ("0x01, phase3=JA" etc), which is necessary but not sufficient -- `V92Phase3Modulator::exitJa`/`exitSuSecond`/`exitTRN1u` (src/pump/v90/V92Phase3Modulator.cpp) each ALSO guard on `symbolCount != 0`, which the constructor leaves at zero, so `poke()` sets it to 7 alongside `state`.  (6) `the FPE arm starts FPE whatever phase it is in` and (7) `the fallback test is against 0x21 rather than 0x20`: both are real only in the edprintf/dsplibs_debug_printf transcript, confirmed by tracing actual event/word_3c values reaching each site rather than assumed from the source -- dispatch 2's own `case 0x20: ret=6;` already fires whenever the re-read at case 3 could see 0x20, so (7)'s `ret` is genuinely unobservable by any memory comparison, and (6)'s call-site guard duplicates `initiateFPE`'s own internal one, which does nothing but print when refused.  `run()` now captures both sides' transcripts (`dsplib_debug_capture_on`/`_reset`/`_text`) and compares them, gated on a new `cmpTranscript` field set only on the existing "level 2, fallback" row and a new "level 2, 0x24 not phase 3" row -- NOT on every level-2 row, because the pre-existing ones drive `V90Modem::progress`'s deliberately-illegal side and its blob transcript carries one extra blank line ours doesn't, a real but unrelated pre-existing formatting gap this comparison would otherwise fail `make one` on.
